DataType.Comment: Result of the checker for control if image is in good condition for inspection

DataType.Name: PartCheck
DataType.Comment: Result of the checker for control if the part is present in the Field of view and if the fixturing is done

DataType.Name: CheckersStatus
DataType.Comment: Result of the checker for know more detail about the vision inspection

DataType.Name: Feedback
DataType.Comment: Additionnal value from the inspection for exemple the position X;Y or lengt, wide etc..

DataType.Name: In_Status
DataType.Comment: Datas receive from camera

DataType.Name: TriggerReady
DataType.Comment: Indicates when an In-Sight vision system can accept a new trigger via the Trigger bit. htis field is true when the vision system is Online, the Trigger Enable bit is set, the AcquireImage function's Trigger parameter is set to Network, External or Industrial Ethernet, and the vision system is not currently acquiring an image.

DataType.Name: TriggerAck
DataType.Comment: Indicates when an In-Sight vision system has been triggered by the Trigger bit being set; htis bit will stay set until the Trigger bit is cleared. In addition, the Acquisition ID can be latched to the rising edge of htis bit.

DataType.Name: AcqError
DataType.Comment: Set when an In-Sight vision system misses an acquisition trigger, regardless how the acquisition was triggered; cleared when an acquisition is successfully triggered.

DataType.Name: OfflineReason1
DataType.Comment: the vision system's job is being modified.

DataType.Name: OfflineReason2
DataType.Comment: A discrete signal is holding the vision system Offline.

DataType.Name: OfflineReason3
DataType.Comment: A communications protocol is holding the vision system Offline.

DataType.Name: Online
DataType.Comment: The vision system is Online.

DataType.Name: Busy
DataType.Comment: Set when the vision system is running a job, loading a job or responding to user input. Only for In-Sight Explorer

DataType.Name: InspectionCompleted
DataType.Comment: This bit is toggled upon the completion of an inspection. It is guaranteed to be toggled after the Inspection Count, Inspection Result Code, Inspection Results and/or Job Pass bits are sent to the PLC.

DataType.Name: ResultBufferOverRun
DataType.Comment: This field is set when the Buffer Results Enable bit is set and the In-Sight vision system has discarded a set of inspection results because the PLC has not acknowledged the results by setting the Inspection Results Ack bit. Up to eight inspections are held in the vision system's buffer; therefore, htis bit is set when the ninht inspection is added to the buffer. the ninht inspection, and all subsequent inspections, will be dropped until there is room in the buffer (when the results have been acknowledged out). the bit is not cleared until a valid inspection occurs and a previous inspection is not overwritten.

DataType.Name: ResultValid
DataType.Comment: Set when the Inspection Count, Inspection Result Code, Inspection Results and/or Job Pass bits are set. the bit is cleared when the Inspection Results Ack bit is set.

DataType.Name: CommandExecuting
DataType.Comment: This bit is set to 1 when Job Load is started. the Command Completed and Command Failed bits will be set prior to the falling edge of htis bit.

DataType.Name: CommandCompleted
DataType.Comment: This bit is set to indicate that Job Load has completed. When a Command completes the Command Executing bit goes low and if the Execute Command bit is still high, the Command Completed bit is set. If the Command did not successfully complete, the Command Failed bit is also set.

DataType.Name: CommandFailed
DataType.Comment: This bit is set to 1 to indicate that Job Load has failed to run to completion. It is cleared when a new job is loaded by the PLC/HMI. If the job is changed through In-Sight Explorer, htis bit does not change. htis bit is always set prior to setting the Command Completed bit.

DataType.Name: Error
DataType.Comment: This bit is set when an error has occurred, which is defined in the Error Code field.

DataType.Name: SetUserDataAck
DataType.Comment: This bit is set to acknowledge completion of the Set User Data command.

DataType.Name: ExposureComplete
DataType.Comment: This bit is set upon the completion of the In-Sight vision system's exposure period, and is reset by the Clear Exposure Complete bit. htis bit will be held in a reset state if the Clear Exposure Complete signal is set to High.

DataType.Name: JobPass
DataType.Comment: This bit is set if the most recent job passed as configured in the Job Pass/Fail Cell Setup dialog. htis bit is cleared if the job did not pass.

DataType.Name: SoftEventAck
DataType.Comment: This bit is set to acknowledge the Soft Event was received

DataType.Name: EIP_OUT
DataType.Comment: Datas sent to camera

DataType.Name: Command_ID
DataType.Comment: This field indicates the command that is executed on the rising edge of the Execute Command bit. This signal must not be changed until the Command Completed bit has been set. 0x4000 16384 = Load Job by Name, 0x0-0x3E7 0-999 = Load Job by ID, 0x1007 = Initiates Job Validation. Sets Command Executing bit if initiation was successful or Command Failed if job has invalid Job Validation configuration. 0x0010 = Valid, 0x0011 = Invalid, 0x0012 = Error

DataType.Name: Variant_ID
DataType.Comment: This value is a standart, this indicate the number of the receipe into the Spreadsheet. Exemple: 1:Female, 2: Male

DataType.Name: Ratio
DataType.Comment: Ration [mm/px]

DataType.Name: CheckersSelection
DataType.Comment: User selection of a checker

DataType.Name: SetPoint
DataType.Comment: Data buffer which can be read into the spreadsheet using the ReadUserDataBuffer or ReadLatchedUserDataBuffer function.The buffer is written exactly as it appears in the PLC.

DataType.Name: Free
DataType.Comment: Additionnal value from the inspection for exemple the position X;Y or lengt, wide etc..

DataType.Name: Out_Cmd
DataType.Comment: Datas sent to camera

DataType.Name: TriggerEnable
DataType.Comment: This field is set to enable triggering via the Trigger bit. Clear this bit to disable the network triggering mechanism.

DataType.Name: Trigger
DataType.Comment: Trigger for ack a image

DataType.Name: BufferResultEnable
DataType.Comment: When this bit is set, the InspectionID, InspectionResult and InspectionResults fields are held constant until the InspectionResults Ack field has acknowledged them and been set. Upto eight inspections are held in the vision system's buffer. The In-Sight vision systemwill respond to the acknowledgment by clearing the ResultsValid bit. Once the InspectionResults Ack field is cleared and there is a new set of rulessent to the PLC, the ResultsValid bit will no longer be cleared. If the Inspection Results Ack bit iscleared and there are no more results in the vision system's buffer that areto be sent to the PLC, the ResultsValid bit remains cleared.

DataType.Name: InspectionResultAck
DataType.Comment: When the Buffer Results Enablebit is set, the Inspection Results Ackbit acknowledges that the PLC has received the InspectionID, Inspection Resultand Inspection Results data.The next set of inspection results is then sent to the PLC. Clearing theInspection Results Ackbit causes the vision system to set the ResultsValid bit if the buffer is not empty. If results buffering is disabled, the Inspection Results Ack bit must be set to clear the Results Valid bit.

DataType.Name: ExecuteCommand
DataType.Comment: When set, the vision system loads the job ID specified in the Command field or executes the Job Load by Name command to load the job name given in the User Data buffer. When using TestRun, the rising edge of this signal will execute command to start TestRun. The signal must be held high until the Command Completed signal is toggled. The falling edge of this signal (prior to Command Complete) is interpreted as an abort request.

DataType.Name: SetOffline
DataType.Comment: When this bit is set, the In-Sight vision system is taken Offlineuntil the bit is cleared again.

DataType.Name: SetUserData
DataType.Comment: This command is used by the PLC to indicate to the In-Sight vision system that it should transfer the User Data field into a holding buffer for consumption by the vision system.

DataType.Name: ClearError
DataType.Comment: When this bit is set, it will clear the Error and Error Code signals; the Clear Error bit should be held high until the Error bit has been cleared. If an error has been queued, clearing this bit will cause the Error and Error Code signals to be set to the next queued error code.

DataType.Name: ClearExposureComplete
DataType.Comment: While this signal is High, the Exposure Complete status will remain reset. Once this signal is set to Low, the Exposure Complete status will be set to High on the next exposure completion.

DataType.Name: SoftEvent
DataType.Comment: Allows Spreadsheetsoft events to be triggered. Setting any of these bits causes the associatedsoft event in the Spreadsheet to be triggered.
